questions.text: T he lateral surface area of a cylinder is 3862.2 cm 2 and its height is 15 cm. Find its volume (take π = 3.14)correct to one decimal place.
A person can paint a 2.5 ft2 of a wall in 5 minutes. How much ft 2 of the wall will he paint in 6 hours?

Dixit covers a certain distance by car, driving at the speed of 28 km/h and he returns to the starting point riding on a scooter at the speed of 36 km/h. Find the average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey.
T he ratio of the cost price of an article to its selling price is 432 ∶ 612. T he profit percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places) on it is:
An amusement park gives an offer to its customers that one person will be given free entry with four other people. What is the effective percentage discount given by the amusement park?
A train covers 40 km between two stations in 45 minutes. It covers another 30 km in 30 minutes and the remaining 20 km in 15 minutes. Find the average speed of the train in the whole journey.
A shopkeeper charges his customer 23% more than the cost price. If a customer paid ₹30,135 for a dining table, then find its original price (in ₹).
S varies directly as (R + 7), and S = 42 when R = 17. What is the value of S when R = 29?
A loan of ₹2,550 is to be paid back in two equal half-yearly instalments. How much is each instalment if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 8% p.a.?
T he average weight of 4 persons is increased by 14 kg when one of them whose weight is 55 kg, is replaced by another person. What is the weight (in kg) of the new person?
A wristwatch is sold for ₹2,700 at a loss of 10%. What is the cost price of the wristwatch?

Two containers of equal capacity are full of mixture of milk and water. In the first, the ratio of milk to water is 3 : 7 and in the second it is 7 : 9. Now both the mixtures are mixed in a bigger container. What is the resulting ratio of milk to water?
45% of Samita’s monthly income is equal to 63% of Anil’s monthly income. If Samita’s monthly income is ₹84,000, what is Anil’s monthly income (in ₹)?
If 6 people are required to complete a work in 1 hour 20 minutes, then how long will only 5 people take to complete the same work?
A and B invested money in a business in the ratio of 2:3. If 10% of the total profit goes to charity and A’s share in the profit is ₹4,500, then what is the total profit?
Manoj earned Rs.6,075 as simple interest on a certain sum at 9% per annum after 5 years. Find the sum invested by him.
T he time taken by R to cover 45 km is 1.2 hours. In how many seconds will he cover 400 metres?
A car covers a distance of 45.6 km in 2.4 litres of petrol. How much distance will it cover in 1 litre of petrol?
T he length of cold storage of cuboidal shape is double its breadth and its height is half of its breadth. If its volume is 216 m3 , then what are the dimensions of the cold storage?
A man can row 9 km/h in still water. If the river is running at 4 km/h, it takes 8 hours more in upstream than to go downstream for the same distance. How far is the place?

A shopkeeper offers a cash discount of ₹275 first and then three successive discounts of 10%, 8% and 5% on the sale of a laptop. If the marked price of the laptop is ₹85,275, find its price for a customer.
T he diagonal of a cubical block of wood is 192 cm. Find its volume.

Sachin purchases a watch from a dealer at some price and sells it at 20% profit. T he next day he purchases the same watch and marks up the price by 75% and offers a discount of 30%. What is the change in the percentage in the profit that Sachin receives on day 2?
Find the least value digit which is assigned to * so that the number 1972*471 is divisible by 9.
